PART 1: Practice the Buddhist scheduled religious practices in daily life

What this means
In this part you learn to practice the Buddhist scheduled religious practices in daily life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practice the Buddhist scheduled religious practices in daily life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn

PART 2: Appreciate the benefits of the Buddhist daily scheduled practices for harmonious living

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the benefits of the Buddhist daily scheduled practices for harmonious living. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it

2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the benefits of the Buddhist daily scheduled practices for harmonious living. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER

2. Practise this skill: practice the Buddhist scheduled religious practices in daily life.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the benefits of the Buddhist daily scheduled practices for harmonious living.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Buddhist Practices the Buddha triple gem precepts meditation sharing of merits. from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Buddhist Practices the Buddha triple gem precepts meditation sharing of merits.: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Buddhist Practices the Buddha triple gem precepts meditation sharing of merits.?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do daily scheduled practices benefit society?
2. How do meditation practices impact one's life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Buddhist Practices the Buddha triple gem precepts meditation sharing of merits. means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
